title: EFT instead of checks – loan ending 0005
correspondence_text:
Hello,

I received my annual escrow account statement dated September 10. It says my escrow account has a surplus of $486.27 and that a check will be mailed to me, and that my monthly payment goes down to $1,562.96 starting November 1.

Can you change this to an EFT instead? I'd rather not keep dealing with paper checks and waiting for them to clear. I've attached the statement.

Thanks,
Danielle Foster
Loan ending 0005
(614) 555-0139
concerns: Borrower asks to change "this" to an EFT without saying whether she means the escrow surplus refund, her monthly mortgage payment or a line-of-credit draw

documents.title: Annual Escrow Account Disclosure Statement
paragraphs: Each year we review your escrow account to make sure there will be enough money to pay your property taxes and homeowners insurance, while keeping the cushion allowed by federal law (no more than one-sixth of the year's projected disbursements).

Your account has a surplus. Because the surplus is $50.00 or more, a refund check for the full surplus will be mailed to you within 30 days of the date of this statement. If your loan becomes past due before the refund is issued, the surplus may be kept in your escrow account instead.
Your new monthly payment begins with the payment due November 1, 2026. If you pay automatically through your bank's bill-pay service, please update the amount.
